purpose: Independent native-ecosystem reconciliation contract for closing discovery blind spots before the G01 production denominator is frozen.
authority: Discovery/reconciliation input only. It never authorizes flash liquidity, trading, execution, profitability or live deployment.

source_surfaces.extraction_contract: Traverse current chain.json records; retain records where status=live AND network_type=mainnet; preserve native chain_id and chain_type; exclude internal metadata directories from denominator.
source_surfaces.identity_rule: Native chain identity first; CAIP-2 or equivalent may be derived only when semantics are explicit.
source_surfaces.current_observation: Current repository inspection exposed 266 named top-level ecosystem directories after excluding internal underscore/dot directories. This is a source-surface count, not a production-chain count.

source_surfaces.extraction_contract: Production denominator includes Mainnet only; Devnet and Testnet remain explicit exclusions.
source_surfaces.identity_rule: Retain Solana native network semantics; do not coerce into EIP-155.

source_surfaces.extraction_contract: Production denominator includes TRON Mainnet; Shasta and Nile remain explicit exclusions.
source_surfaces.identity_rule: Retain TRON namespace and TVM/EVM-compatible execution-plane distinction.

source_surfaces.extraction_contract: Retain Hedera Mainnet as a production candidate and preserve native Hedera semantics alongside EVM compatibility.
source_surfaces.identity_rule: Use Hedera mainnet chain identifier 295 only where directly evidenced by primary documentation.

source_surfaces.extraction_contract: Retain Fuel Ignition Mainnet and exclude Fuel Testnet from production denominator.
source_surfaces.identity_rule: Use native Fuel chain ID 9889; do not infer EIP-155 from numeric similarity.

source_surfaces.extraction_contract: Retain Starknet Mainnet as a native execution network candidate.
source_surfaces.identity_rule: Preserve Starknet native identifier SN_MAIN; do not coerce into EIP-155.

source_surfaces.extraction_contract: Retain Sui production mainnet as a native Move execution candidate.
source_surfaces.identity_rule: Native Sui identity remains distinct from EVM chain IDs.

source_surfaces.extraction_contract: Retain NEAR mainnet and exclude development/test configurations.
Retain Aptos mainnet identity separately from test networks.
Model Sei native Cosmos and EVM execution planes explicitly; reconcile as one network identity only where evidence establishes the relationship.
source_surfaces.identity_rule: Preserve both native pacific-1 and EVM 1329 execution-plane identifiers.

source_surfaces.extraction_contract: Model Injective native and EVM execution planes explicitly.
source_surfaces.identity_rule: Preserve native injective-1 and EVM 1776 without collapsing semantics.
Mainnet identifier 80094 is directly evidenced by ecosystem source.

source_surfaces.extraction_contract: Retain Powerloom Mainnet V2 as a candidate; execution/liquidity remain separate gates.
source_surfaces.identity_rule: Mainnet chain ID 7869 is directly evidenced.

merge_rules: Never use name similarity as identity proof.
Never fabricate EIP-155 identifiers for native networks.
Protocol deployment rows are evidence, not independent chain identities.
Historical snapshots are not current candidates.
One canonical current record per verified network identity.
Conflicting primary observations remain visible and block promotion until resolved.
Native and EVM execution planes may be related without being collapsed into one runtime object.
saturation_requirements: Current source payloads or reproducible fetch procedures exist for every declared source surface.
Independent native surfaces are reconciled against the current G01 source-union.
Semantic duplicates and execution-plane variants are classified.
Unmatched candidates receive primary-source verification or explicit exclusion.
Coverage denominator, exclusions, unknowns and conflicts are quantified.
Control files and Git checkpoint are synchronized.
runtime_boundary: This artifact cannot authorize execution. Live trading remains STOP.
